item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01380","case1_error":"Incorrectly multiplies area by coverage before dividing by coverage, yielding 1200 gallons instead of 3.","case2_error":"Correctly calculates 3 additional hours but answers with the 6-hour total.","reason":"Case 1 uses an erroneous conversion relation; case 2 answers the wrong requested quantity after correctly calculating it.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01381","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final numbers after correct formulas; each person owes $25.","case2_error":"Provides unsupported final answer 450 after correct formulas; the remainder is $75.","reason":"Both append incorrect numbers without showing their evaluation, despite correctly specifying the required calculations.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01382","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 57 + 190 + 152 as 309 instead of 399.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 6 + 8 + 4 + 12 as “2L” instead of 30.","reason":"Both correctly derive the quantities and write the required sum, then give an incorrect result for that explicit expression.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01383","case1_error":"Counts only two houses when totaling Zion's house and his two friends' houses, assuming equal areas.","case2_error":"Treats all three initial packs as packs given away, although only one pack was given.","reason":"Case 1 omits the original participant from the group count; case 2 substitutes the initial stock for the amount transferred.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01384","case1_error":"Omits Saturday's ten additional rounds, understating the total by 300 minutes.","case2_error":"Uses starting inventory plus sales plus shipment, then subtracts starting inventory, instead of subtracting sales from available inventory.","reason":"Case 1 drops an explicitly stated contribution; case 2 includes the data but combines inventory and sales using an erroneous relation.","judgment":"different"}]}
